name: period
description: Reference period the value relates to: a year, financial year, quarter, month, date, or a period of change between two periods.
notes: Not the release date. Lengths of time are not periods: use case_duration, time_in_care, time_in_placement, time_on_order or supervision_duration.

name: state
description: State or territory, including national (Australia) totals.
notes: Keep labels as published, e.g. Tas(b)(c), Aust., Australia excl NT.

name: sex
description: Sex of the person. Court defendant tables may include Organisations.

name: age_group
description: Age or age group, including single years of age and open-ended groups.

name: disability_status

name: measure

name: estimate_type

name: category
description: Too generic.
notes: Name the dimension the labels belong to (sex, method_of_finalisation, ...). If one column stacks several characteristics under captions, make one table per section.

name: characteristic
description: Stacked sections.

name: section
description: Too generic.
notes: Name the concept. For Report on Government Services row outlines, map each level to indicator, service, measure, unit or a characteristic such as indigenous_status; declare a new name if none fits.

name: group
description: Too generic.
notes: Name the concept the labels belong to. For a parent heading over child rows use the dictionary's *_group name if there is one (method_of_finalisation_group, principal_sentence_group).

name: component
description: Ambiguous.

name: level
description: Too generic.

name: outcome
description: Ambiguous.

name: duration
description: Ambiguous.
notes: Use case_duration, time_in_care, time_in_placement, time_on_order or supervision_duration, or declare a specific new name. Reference periods are period.

name: statistic
description: Ambiguous.

name: frequency
description: Ambiguous.

name: supervision
description: Ambiguous.

name: relationship
description: Ambiguous.

name: offence
description: Ambiguous.
